issue.summary: [Backend] System architecture and REST API foundation
issue.description: As a development team, I want a documented system architecture and a REST API skeleton (routing, layered structure, environment configuration, error-handling conventions) so that all subsequent backend features can be built consistently and securely. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the repository is initialised, when the API server starts, then it exposes a health-check endpoint and loads configuration from environment variables. * Given the architecture document, when reviewed by the Product Owner, then all required components (auth, dog records, health records, QR, reporting) are shown to be covered. * Given a new endpoint is added, when a developer follows the project's conventions, then request validation, error responses and logging are consistent with the rest of the API.

As a backend developer, I want a relational database schema covering users, dogs, vaccinations, sterilisations, treatments and QR codes so that all required business data can be stored, related, and queried correctly. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the schema, when reviewed against the required field lists for dogs, vaccinations, sterilisations and treatments, then every required field is represented. * Given a dog record, when a vaccination, sterilisation or treatment is added, then it is correctly linked to that dog's unique Dog ID via a foreign key. * Given the schema, when migrations are run against a fresh database, then they complete without error and are repeatable.

As a registered user (animal welfare worker, veterinarian, or administrator), I want to register an account and log in securely so that I can access the features permitted to my role. Acceptance Criteria: * Given valid registration details, when I submit the registration request, then an account is created with a securely hashed password and I cannot register twice with the same email. * Given correct credentials, when I log in, then I receive a valid session/token scoped to my role. * Given incorrect credentials, when I attempt to log in, then the API rejects the request without revealing whether the email or password was wrong.

As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session cannot be reused from my device after I leave it. Acceptance Criteria: * Given an active session, when I log out, then the session/token is invalidated server-side and further requests using it are rejected.

issue.summary: [Backend] Role-based access control middleware (Guest, Registered User, Administrator)
issue.description: As the system, I want to enforce role-based permissions on every endpoint so that each user can only perform actions permitted to their role. Acceptance Criteria: * Given an unauthenticated request, when a Guest accesses a public endpoint (e.g. view dog profile by QR), then the response includes only publicly permitted fields. * Given a Registered User token, when they call an administrator-only endpoint, then the API returns 403 Forbidden. * Given the permission matrix, when each role calls each endpoint, then the observed behaviour matches the matrix exactly.

issue.summary: [Backend] Secure input validation & sanitisation across API
issue.description: As the system, I want every API endpoint to validate and sanitise its input so that malformed, malicious or oversized data cannot corrupt records or compromise the system. Acceptance Criteria: * Given an endpoint that accepts user input, when invalid or malicious input (e.g. script tags, oversized payloads) is submitted, then the request is rejected with a clear validation error and nothing is persisted. * Given valid input, when submitted, then it is accepted and persisted correctly.

As an animal welfare worker, I want an API to register a new street dog with its Dog ID, sex, approximate age, colour, location, description and photograph so that the dog has a digital profile others can find and update. Acceptance Criteria: * Given required fields are provided, when I submit a registration request, then a new dog profile is created with a unique Dog ID. * Given a required field (e.g. Dog ID reference) is missing, when I submit, then the request is rejected with a specific field error.

As an animal welfare worker or administrator, I want to update a dog's profile information so that records stay accurate over time. Acceptance Criteria: * Given an existing dog profile, when I submit an update to permitted fields, then the change is saved and the profile's last-updated timestamp changes. * Given a field I am not permitted to change for my role, when I attempt to update it, then the request is rejected.

As any user, I want to retrieve a dog's profile information appropriate to my role so that I can see its status and history. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a valid Dog ID, when I request the profile as a Guest, then I receive the publicly permitted fields only. * Given a valid Dog ID, when I request the profile as a Veterinarian, then I receive the full medical and profile record.

issue.summary: [Backend] Search dogs API (by identifier and by location)
issue.description: As a user, I want to search for dogs by ID/description and by location so that I can quickly find a specific dog or dogs in an area. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a search term matching a dog's ID or description, when I search, then matching dog profiles are returned. * Given a location or radius, when I search by location, then dogs registered near that location are returned, ordered by proximity.

As an administrator, I want to edit, merge or remove dog records so that the dataset stays clean and accurate. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a duplicate or invalid dog record, when an administrator removes or merges it, then the change is applied and logged with the administrator's identity and timestamp.

As a veterinarian or authorised animal welfare worker, I want to add, update and retrieve a dog's vaccination records (vaccine type, date, next due date, provider, notes, verification) so that its vaccination history is accurately tracked. Acceptance Criteria: * Given valid vaccination details, when I submit a new record, then it is saved and linked to the correct dog. * Given an existing vaccination record, when I request the dog's vaccination history, then all records are returned in chronological order with the next-due-date visible. * Given a vaccination record submitted by a non-veterinarian, when a veterinarian reviews it, then it can be marked verified.

As a veterinarian, I want to record and update a dog's sterilisation status (date, location, verification) so that duplicate procedures are avoided and status is verifiable. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a dog has no sterilisation record, when I record one, then the dog's sterilisation status changes to "sterilised" with the supporting details stored. * Given a sterilisation record exists, when I request the dog's sterilisation information, then the current status and history are both available.

issue.summary: [Backend] Medical treatment record API (add, update, view)
issue.description: As a veterinarian, animal welfare worker or authorised community member, I want to record and retrieve medical treatments (condition/injury, treatment type, medication, notes, provider, verification) so that a dog's treatment history is complete and trustworthy. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a treatment is administered, when I submit a treatment record, then it is stored with a timestamp, provider identity and verification status. * Given a dog's treatment history is requested, when returned, then entries are ordered chronologically and show verification status per entry.

As any authorised user, I want a single endpoint that summarises a dog's vaccination, sterilisation and treatment status so that I can assess its overall health without reading every individual record. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a dog with vaccination, sterilisation and treatment records, when I request its health summary, then the response shows current status for each category plus the most recent event date.

As the system, I want to generate a unique, scannable QR code linked to each dog's Dog ID so that anyone scanning it is taken directly to that dog's profile. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a newly registered dog, when its QR code is generated, then it encodes a URL that uniquely resolves to that dog's profile and no other dog's. * Given a QR code already exists for a dog, when generation is requested again, then the existing code is returned rather than creating a duplicate identity.

issue.summary: [Backend] QR code scan resolution API, including invalid codes
issue.description: As the system, I want to resolve a scanned QR code to the correct dog profile, and return a clear error for unrecognised codes, so that scanning is reliable and failures are understandable. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a valid QR code is scanned, when resolved, then the correct dog's profile data is returned within an acceptable response time. * Given an invalid or unrecognised code is scanned, when resolved, then a specific "not found" error is returned rather than a generic failure.

As a veterinarian, I want to verify vaccination, sterilisation and treatment records submitted by others so that the platform maintains trust in crowd-sourced medical data. Acceptance Criteria: * Given an unverified record, when a veterinarian marks it verified, then the record's status changes and the verifying veterinarian's identity and timestamp are stored. * Given a record fails verification, when rejected, then it is flagged rather than silently deleted, preserving the audit trail.

As an administrator, I want to view, edit roles for, and deactivate user accounts so that access stays correctly scoped as the team changes. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a list of registered users, when an administrator changes a user's role, then the change takes effect on that user's next request. * Given a user account is deactivated, when that user attempts to log in, then access is denied.

As an administrator or stakeholder, I want an API that returns total dogs tracked, vaccination coverage and sterilisation coverage so that overall programme impact can be reported accurately. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the current dataset, when the statistics endpoint is called, then vaccination and sterilisation coverage percentages match a manual calculation from the underlying records. * Given new records are added, when statistics are requested again, then the figures reflect the latest data.

issue.summary: [Backend] GPS location support in dog records
issue.description: As the system, I want to accept and store a GPS coordinate with a dog's registration or sighting so that location-based search and reporting are possible. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a registration request includes GPS coordinates, when saved, then they are stored and retrievable with the dog's profile.

issue.summary: [Backend] Offline change synchronisation & conflict resolution API
issue.description: As the system, I want to accept a batch of changes made offline and reconcile them with the server's current data, flagging conflicts, so that no field data is lost when connectivity returns. Acceptance Criteria: * Given a set of offline changes with no conflicts, when synced, then all changes are applied and the client is notified of success per item. * Given an offline change conflicts with a newer server-side change to the same record, when synced, then the conflict is flagged for review rather than silently overwritten.

issue.summary: [Backend] Automated database backup and recovery process
issue.description: As the development team, I want automated, regularly scheduled database backups with a documented recovery process so that the platform can recover from data loss. Acceptance Criteria: * Given the backup schedule, when a backup job runs, then a complete, restorable backup is produced and its success/failure is logged. * Given a restore is needed, when the documented recovery process is followed against a backup, then the database is restored to a consistent state.
